subject: Panel runtime placement kickoff — technical + commercial sync
messages:
From: Lucia Moreno <lucia@panellabs.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:07:12 -0700
Subject: Runtime placement for Panel — quick sync?

Hi Mateo,

I lead Partnerships at Panel Labs. We're exploring options to power an on-prem / customer-branded assistant inside our enterprise product (we call it Panel+). We like Redwood's serving model and want to discuss placing Redwood's runtime inside our product as a co-branded (Panel-managed) placement — customers see Panel UI and we handle auth/installer.

High level asks:
- Can Redwood run as a private runtime packaged into our installable?
- How does telemetry / usage reporting work for co-managed deployments?
- Commercial model: per-seat vs committed capacity?
- Timeline: POC in Q3, GA by Q4 if feasible.

I'll attach our high-level product brief. Can we do a 30–45m call next week to align on requirements and next steps?

Thanks,
Lucia Moreno
Head of Partnerships | Panel Labs
lucia@panellabs.com
Attachment: Panel_Redwood_IntroDeck.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Lucia Moreno <lucia@panellabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:22:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime placement for Panel — quick sync?

Hi Lucia — great to hear from you and thanks for the brief. Happy to set up a sync. I'm cc'ing Marissa (Partnerships) to surface commercial context on the call. We'll likely pull Karthik from Solutions on a follow-up for the infra details.

We can cover the items you listed. A few quick notes so we can make the meeting productive:
- For packaging we have two primary private deployment patterns: a self-hosted customer runtime (customer-managed infra) or a partner-embedded runtime (partner-managed installer with optional telemetry hooks).
- Telemetry can be sent to a panel-managed endpoint or proxied to Redwood; there are configurable opt-ins for PII and token-level costs.
- Commercially we support reserved capacity (monthly/annual commit) and a hybrid per-seat overlay for bundled SKUs — happy to walk through examples.

Propose Tue 2027-06-29 10:00am PT or Wed 2027-06-30 9:00am PT — which works for you?

Mateo Alvarez
Director, Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

Lucia — thanks for reaching out. A couple of commercial bullets to seed the conversation before the call: 

Commercial options we usually propose for partner-embedded placements:
- Reserved partner pool: monthly committed GPU hours consumed by all Panel deployments; partner invoices and we provide usage reports. Good for predictable unit economics.
- Marketplace-like reseller SKU: per-seat billing mediated by Redwood, with partner revenue share (requires Lite integration).
- White-label distribution license: upfront platform fee + ongoing support retainer (usually for enterprise/regulated verticals).

Attachments that might be useful for the call: "Proposed_MPA_v1.pdf" (term sheet template) and a draft SOW outline. We'll flag standard legal items (data residency, audit logs, KMS requirements) for the meeting.

If Tue 6/29 10am PT works for Panel, we'll schedule and add a brief agenda: 1) goals & success metrics, 2) security/compliance constraints, 3) packaging and telemetry options, 4) high-level commercial model.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick pre-read from engineering side so we have a focused call: can you share answers to these prior to the meeting if possible?

1) Target customer deployment topology: single-tenant VPC per customer, on-prem air-gapped installer, or SaaS with partner-managed control-plane?
2) Expected QPS / tokens-per-month for the initial POC and for GA (ballpark numbers).
3) Required Latency SLOs (p95) and max token lengths.
4) Data flows: does Panel want transcripts stored on their telemetry endpoints, or should Redwood retain encrypted logs with access controls?
5) Compliance: do you require SOC 2 Type II, GDPR data deletion hooks, or specific region-only hosting?

Also attaching a short engineering checklist we run for partner placements (SOW_outline.docx covers most). For telemetry we can provide a minimal-telemetry build (no token content, only cost + latency stats) or a richer telemetry pipeline with redaction hooks.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Attachment: SOW_outline.docx (docx, 85KB)

From: Lucia Moreno <lucia@panellabs.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 16:42:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime placement for Panel — quick sync?

Thanks — Tue 6/29 10am PT works for us.

Answers in brief:
- Topology: partner-managed installer that can run in customer VPCs (single-tenant per customer preferred). We have an air-gap option for a subset of regulated customers.
- Load: POC ~ 5–10k tokens/day, GA target 3–5M tokens/month across early adopters (10–20 customers).
- Latency: p95 target 400ms for short prompts, 1s acceptable for long contexts (>= 2k tokens).
- Data flows: Panel prefers telemetry to land in their telemetry stack; they must be able to request deletions per GDPR.
- Compliance: SOC 2 is required, plus EU-only hosting for some customers.

Attachments: Panel_Arch_Diagram_v1.png (png, 760KB) — includes our proposed installer flow and where we'd like the runtime to expose health/metrics endpoints.

See you Tuesday — I'll drop a calendar invite with dial-in + WebEx link.

Best,
Lucia
